'''Rana''' was a member of the [[Jedi Colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] established by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]]. While the colony was being evacuated during the [[Invasion of Ossus]], Rana, along with [[Toril (Ossus)|Toril]] and [[Zee (individual)|Zee]], went missing and [[Nadia Grell]] noted that she could not feel them in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
